sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (07:45 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Introduced ourselves, stood by and maintained presence at Hollywood Bakery throughout the day.
Before commencing routes, standby to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery life.
Welfare check along Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Welfare check along Hollywood Cafe Wyndham Street, standby to show our presence.
Patrolling back down Queen Street showing our presence.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, scoped out the area, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Pocket Park, all clear.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed on ground level and level 1, no issues found.
Welfare check along McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, full sweep being commenced and making welfare checks on stores within the location.
Standby to ensure our presence is known while also waiting on further response calls to arise.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Welfare check along Bus Terminal on lower Albert Street, Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, all clear.
Welfare check on Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Welfare check along Federal Square and The Cathedral Church, no issues found.
Welfare check along Good to Go Supermarket and Hollywood Cafe, all clear.
Response call from Management, requesting our assistance at HQ.
Arrived at HQ, standby for further updates.
Response call from Albert Mart Convenience Store, reporting an aggressive customer who walked in and verbally insulted the staff.

Arrived at response location, poi had already left the area, last seen heading up Albert Street. Photo of the individual has been retrieved. (posted onto Auror) Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls while watching to see if the poi returns.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance. Ending Alpha Route now.

Patrolling up Albert Street ensuring our presence is known. Arrived at Hollywood Cafe Wyndham Street, notified them that the same poi who tried to steal has now been spotted in the area by another store. Advised them to keep an eye out and to call us immediately.
Welfare check on Little Albert's Cafe and The People's Barista, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Top of Victoria Street, welfare checks commenced along all stores within the location, all clear. Standby for response calls while ensuring our presence is visible.
Continuing our patrols due to no issues occurring.
Arrived at the corner intersection between Albert and Wellesley Street, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square, full walkthrough completed within the location, checked into Aotea Centre and Jack's Fried Chicken, all clear.
Standby to ensure our presence is known while waiting for response calls to arise.
Continuing our patrols due to no issues found.
Arrived at check-in Top of Mayoral Drive, full scope out of the area, no issues found.
Welfare check along Queens Food Court, all clear.
Welfare check along Munster Inn and Nandos, all clear.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, no issues. Commencing welfare checks along all stores and businesses within Lorne Street.
Commencing welfare checks along High Street stores, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Chancery Square, full sweep completed within the vicinity, no issues found. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Welfare check along Vulcan Lane, all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible in the area.
Welfare check along McDonald's Britomart, no issues. Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, full walkthrough completed along Tyler and Galway Street, all clear.

Response call from Mac Pac, reporting a white male individual involved in theft. Photo will be attached. (posted onto Auror) Last seen heading down towards Britomart. Standing by and keeping our eyes open for the individual to walk down.
Patrolling up Queen Street scoping out for the individual who stole from Mac Pac.
Arrived at Mac Pac, notified them that we will keep an eye out in case he is still around.
Arrived at check-in Kiwi Bank, no issues found. Welfare checks commenced along all stores within the location.

Arrived at check-in Bottom of Fort Street, welfare check completed within all stores in the area, no reports have been made. Standby to ensure our presence is known and waiting on response calls and incidents to occur.
On route to HQ now due to the Ops Phone running low on battery once again.
Response call from Dangerfield, reporting a female individual who is trespassed from the store, currently inside at the moment. Requesting assistance to remove her or get her to leave.

Arrived at response location; poi had bought something from the store. After escorting her out, we notified her that she is trespassed from Dangerfield due to recent disorderly behaviour in the past, and also intoxication and verbal abuse towards the staff. The female poi did not take it lightly and reacted unsettlingly to the news. Requested a refund for the item she bought.
As I was going to ask if she could refund the item, the poi walked back into the store, so we escorted her out once more and told her to wait outside until I had confirmed she could get a refund.

Poi was able to get her refund; after some time, she calmly apologized for the outbreak of emotions. Advised her not to return to the store because police will be notified of the issue. Ensuring our presence is well known and visible to all stores within the area.
Arrived at HQ, taking our break now and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:00)
items: Equipment received: Ops Phone (low battery, on charge now), 2 x Radios, 2 x Cameras, 2 x Keycards (with Tupono).
Standing by HQ as the ops phone charges and awaiting the second guard; no power bank located to take during patrols.

Received a response call from Dangerfield Queen Street regarding an incident handled during the morning shift; the caller stated that a female suspect had left some paper in the area and was said to be waiting for us to arrive.

Arriving at Dangerfield Queen Street now; the woman who has previously breached a trespass notice had entered the store and caused a public disturbance by yelling at the staff. She has left us a note and we have a copy of the previous trespass notice. Suspect has left the area, standing by to show presence. (photos on file)
Moving onwards back onto Queen Street, returning to patrol; notified Dangerfield staff to contact us back should the woman return.
Customs Street check, no issues, making our way through the area.
Hourly check-in, no issues to note.
Response call from Downlow Burgers regarding an intoxicated male causing trouble for the store; staff feel unsafe and need HOTC support, making our way over.
Arrived at Downlow Burger; male causing problems for the store and stealing food from nearby vendors, standing by the area in case he returns. (photo on file)
Moving on but keeping in the area as the male is still hanging around; staff concerned he may return when we leave.
Male appears to have left the area, so we will move onwards.
Customs Street clear, moving on towards Commercial Bay.
Q Convenience clear, no issues with the vagrants in the area.
Hourly check-in, no issues to report.
Fort Lane check, following up on a notice made by a member of the public regarding a male causing trouble and being loud in the area, standing by and keeping vigilant watch over the area.
Call received from a strange number; unsure who the caller was but they were incoherent and it was not a contact saved on our number, listing down for reference.

Response call received from Dangerfield regarding the same female as earlier; the caller stated the female has returned to the door, thrown stuff inside the store (will update what was thrown when we arrive) and yelled insults at the staff.

While passing the bathrooms on Fort Lane we were approached by an erratic vagrant who appeared to be having an episode; we calmly asked if he was alright, heard him out and then sent him on his way, standing by for a few minutes. (video on file)
Dangerfield check, no problems or signs of damage or objects in the area; the store has also just closed and staff have given the all clear, moving along Queen Street.
Darby Street clear, Darby Street station cleared of vagrants.
Elliott Atrium check, no issues in the area and security are all clear.
Elliott Stables welfare check, no problems.
Hourly check-in, no issues to report.
Jungle 8 check-in, no issues, standing by the area for a bit as activity and rowdy crowds increase.
Back on Queen Street, no issues, heading to check on Maccas and Timezone.
Call received from CBD cleaners, asking us to let him inside the level 1 office as he does not have his keycard, will make our way over shortly.
McDonald's and Timezone check-ins, no issues.
Footlocker and Localito checks, no issues.
Back at HQ, letting the cleaners inside; will stay back for a bit to make sure the door is closed properly, having our meal break now too.
Hourly check-in, no issues to report; will make way back to HQ to let the next guard inside who starts at 20:00. Battery getting low again, standing by till phone charges.
Let in the other guard for the late afternoon/night shift.
Hourly check-in, no issues to report.
Hourly check-in, no issues to report.
Afternoon shift concluded, no issues to report, handing over to Night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing a small debrief with the night team before heading out on patrols.
Welfare check on McDonald's Queens and all remaining businesses open within the area, patrolling up to Aotea Square to commence sweep.
Arrived at Aotea Square; a lot of footwork in the area so we will be maintaining security presence as well as commencing sweep.
Removed alcohol from a male individual drinking in public, all clear, no issues.
Member of the public asked for directions to Sapphires Nightclub; guided them to their destination, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Aotea Square, stand down security presence, continuing patrols through Mayoral Drive.
Received a response call from Bar101 entrance regarding a male delinquent causing a disturbance in front of the bar, en route to location.

Arrived at response location; the male individual was already outside shouting and screaming at the guards at Bar101. We approached them to ask what the situation was and were told this male individual was inappropriately touching girls who were outside Bar101. We asked this male individual to leave the site, which he did with no harm caused. (photo on file) All clear, no issues, standing by Bar101 maintaining security presence.
Welfare check Bar101, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ to charge the ops work phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at Headquarters, standing by waiting for any response calls to arise.
Commencing patrols along lower Queen Street.
Full sweep lower Queen Street, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, no issues identified, heading to Britomart to commence welfare check.
Arrived at Britomart, sweeping the area before continuing patrols due to a lot of footwork around the area.
Removed alcohol from a minor individual who is drinking in public, all clear, no issues.
Britomart full sweep, welfare check McDonald's and guard, all clear, no issues, continuing patrols.
Welfare check Kemuri and Reign N Pour, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Quay Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Q Convenience Store, all clear, no issues, patrolling Fort Lane.
Arrived at Fort Lane, commencing sweep.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, standing by showing security for any identified risk.
Stand down security presence at Sapphire, full sweep Fort Lane and Fort Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Shortland Street, bottom of High Street, welfare check Shortland Mart, all clear, no issues to report, commencing patrols up High Street to Freyberg.
Bottom half of High Street, Vulcan Lane swept, welfare check any remaining businesses open within the area, all clear, no issues, heading to Freyberg / Chancery Square.
Arrived at Freyberg Place, commencing sweep, not much footwork seen in the area.
Freyberg Place, Chancery Square sweep, all clear, no issues, continuing patrols on Lorne Street.
Lorne Street centre sweep, welfare check Red Radisson, all clear, no issues identified.
Whole of Lorne Street patrolled, all clear, no issues identified in the area, patrolling up to Aotea Square to commence sweep.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep around the area.

Saw a brawl that was suspected of happening at Aotea Square; as we walked up to show our presence, the group of individuals suspected of fighting had left the scene without any risks seen, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Aotea Square, no issues identified in the area, continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Arrived at McDonald's Queens, standing by due to a lot of individuals posted in the premises.
Response call from Bar101 entrance regarding a suspect that was notified to us, en route to location.

Arrived at response location; when we arrived, the Bar101 manager had already told us they had left due to being notified the cops were on their way, standing by Bar101 showing security presence for any other issues that might occur in the area.

While showing security presence at Bar101, in the corner in front of Domino's we saw 3 male individuals assaulting another male individual; as we enforced interaction they immediately stopped fighting and went on about their day. (photo on file)
Welfare check Bar101, all clear, no issues to report, continuing patrols.
Sweep Darby Street / Elliott Street, all clear, no further issues, patrolling up Victoria Street.
Sweep Victoria Street West, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, no further issues.
Full sweep Federal Street, check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, Liston House, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues, heading down Queen Street to Britomart.
Welfare check Britomart McDonald's / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Completed check Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues, patrolling up High Street to Freyberg for full sweep.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square, all clear, no issues.

Received a call from McDonald's Queen Street notifying us of a male vagrant causing a disturbance in the premises; was en route to location but received another call from McDonald's Queens that the vagrant had fully left the premises and was no longer in need of assistance, will welfare check during patrols.
Swept corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear, no issues, patrolling up to Aotea Square.
Full sweep Aotea Square, all clear, no issues to report, no footwork in the area, heading down Queen Street to welfare check on McDonald's.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, no issues to report, heading to HQ to commence break and standby for guard handover, responding to any calls that occur.
Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
